annotations.title: Find the contacts that are probably one party

description: The pairs of active contacts of a company that are probably one party — two spellings of one customer, two imports of one supplier — strongest first. Each pair names the contact to keep (the one more ledger lines and documents name, then the older) and the one to absorb, a score from 0 to 1, the kinds of evidence (vat_number, registration_number, account: the same number or bank account, score 1; name: the same significant words in any order, or every word of one in the other, 0.950 for the same name, 0.900 otherwise, 0.600 when those words reach several contacts) and the evidence in sentences. Two contacts with different VAT or registration numbers, a contact and its own parent, and inactive or merged contacts are never proposed. It writes nothing: show the user both contacts and call merge_contacts only on a pair they confirm, with the contact they choose to keep.

company_id.description: The company to work in. Ask list_companies if unsure.
